decisions.reason: The waterproof lined range sits at the core of the firm's announced focus on climate and comfort in safety footwear, and the firm has invested development and certification resources in it, so management would keep it despite thin evidence after 2019.

ESD occupational shoes serve steady demand from electronics and industrial customers, are close to the established offer and have already been certified, so the sunk investment and strategic fit favor persistence.

The safety shoe series was publicly launched as part of the firm's innovation-driven identity, and any weak results can be attributed to temporary pandemic-related disruption, so management would continue it rather than admit failure.
